Test Scenario: Power-On Reset State of Line Status & Control Registers
Test Description: Apply system reset (rst_n_i=0). Read UART_LSR (offset 0x14) and UART_IER (offset 0x04). Monitor uart_tx_o.
Expected Result: UART_LSR reads 0x60 (THRE=1, TEMT=1, DATA_READY=0); UART_IER reads/initializes to 0; uart_tx_o is held at idle high (1'b1); RX and TX FIFOs empty.

Test Description: Write reset pattern to UART configuration to re-initialize internal FIFOs and baud divisor registers.
Expected Result: FIFOs cleared; internal write and read pointers reset to 0; transmitter holding register empty flag remains 1'b1.

Test Scenario: Programmable Baud Rate Generator (115200 Baud Divisor)
Test Description: Set DLAB=1 in UART_LCR; write baud divisor 868 (0x0364) for 115200 baud at 100 MHz clock into UART_BAUD_DIV. Reset DLAB=0. Transmit test character.
Expected Result: Each bit period on uart_tx_o measures exactly 8.68 us (868 clock cycles at 10 ns clock period); baud rate timing accuracy within 0.1% tolerance.

Test Description: Write character 'A' (0x41 = 01000001b) into UART_THR (offset 0x00).
Expected Result: uart_tx_o outputs: 1 start bit (low), 8 data bits LSB-first (1,0,0,0,0,0,1,0), no parity bit, 1 stop bit (high); total frame duration = 10 bit periods (86.8 us).

Test Description: Stream string "TEST" (0x54, 0x45, 0x53, 0x54) by writing consecutive bytes to UART_THR upon THRE detection.
Expected Result: 4 contiguous 10-bit frames transmitted on uart_tx_o with valid start/stop framing for each character; no data corruption or truncated bits.

Test Description: External UART VIP drives serial frame with data byte 0x52 ('R') into uart_rx_i at 115200 baud with 1 start bit and 1 stop bit.
Expected Result: Receiver samples at mid-bit intervals; byte 0x52 pushed into RX FIFO; UART_LSR[0] (DATA_READY) asserts high; reading UART_RBR returns 0x52.

Test Scenario: Multi-Character Burst Reception into RX FIFO
Test Description: External VIP drives 4 consecutive characters ("RISC") into uart_rx_i without inter-frame pause.
Expected Result: All 4 characters loaded into RX FIFO in arrival order; reading UART_RBR sequentially returns 'R', 'I', 'S', 'C'; DATA_READY clears after 4th read.

Test Scenario: Transmitter Holding Register Empty (THRE) Flag Operation
Test Description: Monitor UART_LSR[5] (THRE) while writing data to UART_THR.
Expected Result: THRE momentarily drops to 0 when byte is written to THR and returns to 1 as soon as byte is transferred to internal shift register, signaling ready for next write.

Test Scenario: Transmitter Empty (TEMT) Shift Completion Flag Operation
Test Description: Monitor UART_LSR[6] (TEMT) during byte transmission.
Expected Result: TEMT remains 0 while data or stop bits are actively shifting out on uart_tx_o; asserts to 1 only after stop bit completes and transmitter is fully idle.

Test Scenario: Line Control Register (UART_LCR) Stop Bits Configuration
Test Description: Configure UART_LCR for 1 stop bit versus 2 stop bits. Transmit test character in each mode.
Expected Result: Stop bit duration measures 1 bit period (8.68 us) in 1 stop bit mode and 2 bit periods (17.36 us) in 2 stop bits mode on uart_tx_o.

Test Description: Drive uart_cts_i high (ready) then toggle low (not ready) during string transmission. Monitor uart_tx_o.
Expected Result: When uart_cts_i is high, transmission proceeds; when uart_cts_i is driven low, current byte completes and subsequent byte transmission stalls until CTS returns high.

Test Scenario: RX FIFO Full Depth Capacity Verification
Test Description: Drive 16 consecutive characters into uart_rx_i without CPU reading UART_RBR.
Expected Result: RX FIFO stores all 16 bytes without error; sequential reads of UART_RBR retrieve all 16 bytes in exact FIFO sequence; DATA_READY remains 1 until 16th read.

Test Description: External VIP sends continuous stream of characters where start bit of next frame begins immediately on clock edge following stop bit of previous frame.
Expected Result: Receiver maintains framing synchronization across stream; no bit slippage or frame misalignment occurs across 100+ contiguous bytes.

Test Description: Configure baud divisors for 9600 baud (10416), 57600 baud (1736), and 115200 baud (868). Transmit test character in each configuration.
Expected Result: Transmitted bit durations match nominal baud periods (104.16 us, 17.36 us, 8.68 us) within +/- 1% tolerance across all baud configurations.

Test Scenario: Stop Bit Framing Error Detection & Recovery
Test Description: Drive serial character where 10th bit (stop bit) is held low (0'b0) instead of expected high (1'b1).
Expected Result: Receiver flags framing error; false frame is handled gracefully without core hang; receiver re-synchronizes on subsequent valid idle line and start bit.

Test Description: Transmit 17 consecutive bytes into uart_rx_i when FIFO depth is 16 without reading RBR.
Expected Result: Overrun error condition triggered; oldest 16 bytes preserved intact; 17th byte dropped or recorded per specification; core remains operational.

Test Description: Inject transient negative glitch on uart_rx_i lasting 3 clock cycles (< 1/16th bit period).
Expected Result: Glitch filter / mid-bit sampling detects false start bit; receiver ignores glitch, does not push false byte to RX FIFO, and remains in IDLE.

Test Description: Issue AHB read to UART register offset 0x04 (UART_IER) or 0x08 (which are write-only or unmapped for reads in axi_uart_top FSM).
Expected Result: Bridge multiplexer handles non-decoded read by returning bounded response with sys_hready=1; bus does not hang; core execution continues.

Test Description: Write 1 to UART_IER[0] to enable RX data available interrupt. Send character to uart_rx_i.
Expected Result: Upon character reception into RX FIFO, read_interrupt_o (uart_irq) asserts high immediately.

Test Scenario: RX Interrupt Deassertion via UART_RBR Read
Test Description: When uart_irq is asserted, perform read of UART_RBR register to drain RX FIFO.
Expected Result: Reading UART_RBR pulses rx_fifo_pull_int; RX FIFO empties; read_interrupt_o (uart_irq) deasserts to 0.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal Interrupt Signal: uart_irq to PIC extintsrc_req[4])

Test Scenario: PIC External Interrupt Source 4 Integration & ISR Service
Test Description: Enable PIC source 4 for UART. Drive character 'R' on uart_rx_i.
Expected Result: uart_irq asserts extintsrc_req[4]; core enters ISR; ISR reads UART_RBR (0x52) into buffer and clears PIC gateway (MEIGWCLR(4)); ISR exits cleanly.
